1.3.text: Implement nationally appropriate social protection systems and measures for all, including floors, and by 2030 achieve substantial coverage of the poor and the vulnerable.
1.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

3.8.text: Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection, access to quality essential health-care services and access to safe, effective and affordable essential medicines and vaccines for all.
3.8.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

4.3.text: By 2030, ensure equal access for all women and men to affordable and quality technical, vocational and tertiary education, including university.
4.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

4.4.text: By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.
4.4.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.2.text: Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation, including through a focus on high-value added and labour-intensive sectors.
8.2.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.5.text: By 2030, achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men, including for young people and persons with disabilities, and equal pay for work of equal value.
8.5.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.6.text: By 2020, substantially reduce the proportion of youth not in employment, education or training.
8.6.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.10.text: Strengthen the capacity of domestic financial institutions to encourage and expand access to banking, insurance and financial services for all.
8.10.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

10.2.text: By 2030, empower and promote the social, economic and political inclusion of all, irrespective of age, sex, disability, race, ethnicity, origin, religion or economic or other status.
10.2.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

12.6.text: Encourage companies, especially large and transnational companies, to adopt sustainable practices and to integrate sustainability information into their reporting cycle.
12.6.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

16.4.text: By 2030, significantly reduce illicit financial and arms flows, strengthen the recovery and return of stolen assets and combat all forms of organized crime.
16.4.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

16.5.text: Substantially reduce corruption and bribery in all their forms.
16.5.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

16.6.text: Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.
16.6.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

2.1.text: By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round.
2.1.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

3.3.text: By 2030, end the epidemics of AIDS, tuberculosis, malaria and neglected tropical diseases and combat hepatitis, water-borne diseases and other communicable diseases.
3.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

3.9.text: By 2030, substantially reduce the number of deaths and illnesses from hazardous chemicals and air, water and soil pollution and contamination.
3.9.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

4.1.text: By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes.
4.1.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

6.3.text: By 2030, improve water quality by reducing pollution, eliminating dumping and minimizing release of hazardous chemicals and materials, halving the proportion of untreated wastewater and substantially increasing recycling and safe reuse globally.
6.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

7.2.text: By 2030, increase substantially the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix.
7.2.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

7.3.text: By 2030, double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency.
7.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.8.text: Protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments for all workers, including migrant workers, in particular women migrants, and those in precarious employment.
8.8.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

8.9.text: By 2030, devise and implement policies to promote sustainable tourism that creates jobs and promotes local culture and products.
8.9.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

9.1.text: Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure, including regional and transborder infrastructure, to support economic development and human well-being, with a focus on affordable and equitable access for all.
9.1.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

9.4.text: By 2030, upgrade infrastructure and retrofit industries to make them sustainable, with increased resource-use efficiency and greater adoption of clean and environmentally sound technologies and industrial processes, with all countries taking action in accordance with their respective capabilities.
9.4.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)

16.3.text: Promote the rule of law at the national and international levels and ensure equal access to justice for all.
16.3.source: UN Sustainable Development Goals, official target text (sdgs.un.org)
